review_basis: Independently compared exact proposed bytes to approved v6: product scope/non-goals and existing requirements unchanged; one explicit portable-cwd requirement and mapped suite coverage added with proposal metadata.
Reserved assessed producer-root variable is canonical absolute, enforced against real execution root before capture command, bound to recorded cwd/environment and required at consumer.
Consumer portability explicitly avoids current-root equality while revalidating current repository/source/material/index/context and requires explicit caller environment without mutation.
Missing-key, producer mismatch, tampered-cwd and real equivalent-clone proof-transfer cases are required; no metadata authenticity claim added.
